summary: When single-type observe uses buffered:true, enqueue matching previously buffered entries and queue observer delivery.

semantics.delivery: append matches then queue PerformanceObserver task
semantics.bounded: buffering is entry-type-defined and not universally unbounded

tests.name: buffered delivery
tests.expected_behavior: queued callback can receive matching pre-existing buffered entries where that type supports buffering

tests.name: not synchronous
tests.input: let called=false; performance.mark('before'); const o=new PerformanceObserver(()=>called=true); o.observe({type:'mark',buffered:true}); console.log(called);
tests.expected_behavior: prints false before queued observer task runs
